why.en: With he we say has got: has, not have or is, and the word got does not change.
why.uz: He bilan has got ishlatiladi: have yoki is emas, has; got soʻzi oʻzgarmaydi.
why.ru: С he используется has got: has, а не have или is; слово got не меняется.

stem.en: ___ your brother got a phone? — Yes, he has.

why.uz: Your brother = he, shuning uchun savol Has bilan boshlanadi; Yes, he has javobi ham shuni koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Your brother = he, поэтому вопрос начинается с Has; это видно и по ответу Yes, he has.
